sloka: नात्र शक्यं बलं ज्ञातुं तव वा तस्य वाऽधिकम् ।आर्द्रं शुष्कमिति ह्येतत्सुमहद्राघवान्तरम् ॥४-११-८९॥।।
transliteration: nātra śakyaṁ balaṁ jñātuṁ tava vā tasya vā'dhikam ।ārdraṁ śuṣkamiti hyetatsumahadrāghavāntaram ॥4-11-89॥।।

translations.english: 'I was unable to gauge whether your strength is more than his (Vali's) since there is a great difference between a dry body and a wet one.
